title: Gate Values Are Bounded by the Modulus
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $k$ be a positive natural number, let $a:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, let $vs$ be a list of natural numbers, and let $g$ be an arithmetic gate on $n$ inputs. The value of $g$ computed from $a$ and $vs$ modulo $k$ is strictly less than $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $vs$ is a list of natural numbers
$g$ is an arithmetic gate on $n$ inputs
